# Provenance of this schema

**Derived from the documentation, NOT generated by `codex app-server generate-json-schema`.**

- Source: the README of `codex-rs/app-server` at tag **`rust-v0.130.0`**
  (`https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openai/codex/rust-v0.130.0/codex-rs/app-server/README.md`,
  read 2026-10-05), plus the provider review of the same day for the MCP elicitation
  (`mcpServer/elicitation/request`, `meta.codex_approval_kind`, `persist`) and for
  `codexErrorInfo`.
- `codex app-server generate-json-schema` is **unavailable**: the only `codex` installed where
  this was written is **0.38.0**, which has no `app-server` subcommand. No real
  `codex app-server` was ever run. No message in `../sessions/` was recorded: the
  transcripts are written by hand from the README and replayed by `src/bin/fake_codex.rs`.
- Stable surface only: `initialize.params.capabilities.experimentalApi` is never sent, so the
  `dynamicTools`, `item/tool/requestUserInput`, `thread/turns/list`, `process/*`,
  `collaborationMode/*` and `permissions`-profile parts of the protocol are not used.

## NOT VERIFIED (named in `messages.json` as `not_verified` where it applies)

| Item | Why |
|---|---|
| `thread/tokenUsage/updated` fields (`total`, `last`, `modelContextWindow`, camelCase token names) | the README names the notification, not its shape: from memory |
| `_meta.tool_name`, `_meta.tool_params` of a tool-approval elicitation | the README names `codex_approval_kind` and `persist` only |
| the answer to a persistent approval (`_meta.persist` in the response) | from memory |
| spelling of `approvalPolicy` (`on-request`) and `sandbox` (`workspaceWrite`) at `thread/start` | the README shows `never` / `workspaceWrite` there, and `unlessTrusted` for `turn/start`; the 0.38 help lists `untrusted, on-failure, on-request, never` |
| `thread/start.baseInstructions` / `developerInstructions` | from memory |
| `thread/start` / `thread/resume` results carrying `model` | from memory |
| `threadId` on every notification (the README shows `{ turn }` for the turn events) | the adapter treats a missing `threadId` as the main thread |
| delivery to this client of the events of a sub-agent thread | the README documents `collabToolCall` only |

## Re-generating against a real Codex

When a `codex` >= `0.130.0` is installed (`codex --version`), from `claude-code-sdk-rs/`:

```
codex app-server generate-json-schema --out /tmp/codex-schema-$(codex --version | awk '{print $NF}')
CODEX_BIN=$(command -v codex) cargo test -p nexus-claude --features provider-codex \
    --test codex_schema_drift -- --ignored real_codex_schema_still_names_everything_we_use
```

The ignored test regenerates the bundle into a temp directory and fails when a method or a
field this adapter needs is no longer named in it. To adopt a new version: make a sibling
directory `tests/transcripts/codex/<new version>/`, regenerate `messages.json` from the real
schema (keeping `required` / `conditional` / `optional` honest), re-record the sessions with
a real login, change the `provenance` line of this file to say so, and raise
`MIN_APP_SERVER_VERSION` in `src/providers/codex/mod.rs` if the floor moved.
